senses.gloss: m. (preced.) joint, angle, esp. two sides of a rectangle.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 55a:5">Erub. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>כמין גם</he> Ar. (ed. <he>גאם</he>) in the shape of a right angle.
<cite ref="Zevachim 53b:5">Zeb. 53ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="C00994"><he>גמא</he></cite> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 441:1">Yalk. Lev. 441</cite> <he>גאם</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 8b:14">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>שורה אחת כמין ג׳</he> one row of wine vessels, in the shape of &c., i.e. the front and the whole upper layer. Y. ib. I, 27ᵇ bot. <he>קולפו כמין גם</he>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:8">Kel. XIV, 8</cite> (<he>מפתח</he>) <he>של גם שנשבר מתוך גומו</he> a key whose bit is joined (opp. to <he>של ארכובה</he> of one piece) broken at its junction. [<cite ref="Shabbat 105a:12">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>על הגם</he> Ar., ed. <he>על הגַּס</he>, q. v.]—Pl. <he>גַּמִּים</he>, <he>גַּמִּין</he>. Y. Pes. l. c. <he>קולפו כמין שני ג׳</he> he takes off for examination two front and two upper layers, v. supra. Ib. if the vessels are arranged like steps <he>קולפו ג׳ ג׳</he> he must examine by front and upper layers on each landing.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 28a:7">B. Mets. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מדת גַּמָּיו</he> the combined measure of both dimensions of a piece of goods, square measure, opp. <he>מדת ארכו ומדת רחבו</he> the measure of each dimension specified.—
Sabb. 103ᵇ גַּמִּין, v. גי״מל.—[Commentators explain our w. = Greek Gamma, Γ, whence the Var. גַּמָּא.]
